import re
import sys

assign = re.compile(r"\s*([a-p]|TMP)\s*<-\s*(\d+)\s*;\s*")
add = re.compile(
    r"\s*([a-p]|TMP)\s*<-\s*"
    r"\(\s*([a-p]|TMP)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100\s*;\s*"
)

values = {}

for line in sys.stdin:
    match = assign.fullmatch(line)
    if match:
        name, value = match.groups()
        values[name] = int(value)
        continue

    match = add.fullmatch(line)
    if match:
        name, source, amount = match.groups()
        if name != source:
            raise ValueError(f"Unexpected source variable: {line.strip()}")
        values[name] = (values[name] + int(amount)) % 100

names = [*map(chr, range(ord("a"), ord("p") + 1)), "TMP"]
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in names) + ";")
